capabilities: Sync notes two ways between the vault and a Fokus account
Upload embedded images and map them to URLs in Fokus
Convert body tags and frontmatter tags into Fokus tags and map folders to buckets
Hold edit locks while editing and write conflict copies when both sides change
Run manual, polled, and full-folder sync from commands with a persisted queue
extras: Warns that Obsidian's keychain is shared between plugins, so another plugin could read the token; recommends a revocable token. Notes that content conversion to canonical markdown happens on Fokus's side, lists lossy and unsupported cases (Canvas, mobile, callouts, footnotes, Dataview syntax), and says deletion only unlinks rather than deleting in Fokus.
motivation: The README says a vault "is very good at writing things down and not good at being asked questions", so synced notes can inform Fokus search, its assistant, and planning.
problem: Notes in an Obsidian vault stay local and cannot be searched, linked to tasks, or read on the phone through Fokus.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault notes into Fokus.

requires.name: Fokus API token created in Settings → Integrations → Obsidian

summary: Two-way sync that keeps vault notes, tags, folder mappings and embedded images in a Fokus account, with edit locks and conflict copies.
